notes.title: Patch 3: Optimized UI and Post-Processing FX
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Optimized UI: better layout of buttons and interface according to screen resolutions
[*] Post-Processing FX: added post-processing function for better visual rendering
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2: Management of screen resolutions
notes.content: The game interface was displayed poorly on certain screen resolutions (ex: 2560 x 1080). The game now detects the resolution when launching the game and adapts the interface so that all elements can be displayed.

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content: A flaw in the autosave function was freezing the game when changing levels after the tutorial. Now corrected! Enjoy!
